subject: Packaging options for BlueWave — Growth bundle vs. Dedicated Tier
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0000
Subject: Packaging options for BlueWave — Growth bundle vs. Dedicated Tier

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on your ingestion patterns and the two feature areas you flagged (real-time patient summarization and embedding-powered search). Per our discussion I wanted to outline the packaging options that map to BlueWave's priorities so you can weigh upgrade vs. feature-bundle approaches.

Short summary (attached comparison):
- Growth bundle (recommended for 6–18 month POC): Growth tier + Embeddings add-on + 2x reserved throughput on sensitive routes. Includes token-level cost cap and up to 10k monthly evals.
- Dedicated Tier (recommended if you need strict SLAs & predictable throughput): Dedicated GPU pool with reserved capacity, optional VPC Private plan, 99.9% targeted uptime.

Key tradeoffs:
- Cost predictability: Dedicated > Growth bundle (lower unit variance).
- Time-to-value: Growth bundle can start within days; Dedicated requires provisioning lead time.
- Feature availability: Embeddings and Reranking are identical across both; Private deployment features (KMS/HSM) are only in VPC/private Dedicated.

Next steps I propose:
1) If you want a quick POC, we spin up Growth bundle for 3 months and include the embeddings add-on.
2) If procurement needs a formal quote for a Dedicated commitment, I’ll loop in our Finance/Legal to draft a 12-month pricing term.

I attached a short comparison and a starter pricing table. Priyom is cc'd to share technical POC items (sample prompts, rate limits). Rishi — can you confirm if we can offer the 15% first-year onboarding credit we discussed last quarter so I can include it in the quote?

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if it helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Solutions
Redwood Inference
(attachment: BlueWave-GrowthBundle-Compare.pdf)
(attachment: pricing-table-3yr.xlsx)
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Packaging options for BlueWave — Growth bundle vs. Dedicated Tier

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we commit to a POC:

1) For the Growth bundle, are there soft limits on concurrent requests that would impact our real-time summarization for triage (target: p95 < 400ms for 250rpm peaks)?
2) Does the embeddings add-on include automatic prefix caching or is that a separate opt-in? We expect a lot of repeated queries for patient lookup.
3) If we later convert to Dedicated, can we credit the Growth spend? Procurement is asking whether any commit credit applies.

Procurement also asked for a short version of the plan matrix to include in the internal packet. Could you provide an abbreviated table (one-pager) showing feature availability and a sample 12-month price comparison with and without the 15% onboarding credit?

If that all looks good we can run a two-week POC for a subset of clinical workflows.

Best,
Emily Carter
Director of Product, BlueWave Health

Subject: Re: Packaging options for BlueWave — Growth bundle vs. Dedicated Tier

Thanks Emily — answers below and I've attached the one-pager you can drop into Procurement's packet.

1) Concurrency and latency: Growth bundle uses continuous batching with workload-aware routing. For the profile you gave (250rpm with spiky bursts) we can hold p95 ~350–420ms depending on prompt length. If that p95 SLA is critical we recommend Dedicated with a throughput reservation.

2) Embeddings add-on: includes automatic prefix/KV caching tuned for repeated lookups — no separate opt-in. We also include a small query cache for cold-starts.

3) Credit on conversion: Yes — we can apply Growth spend as a one-time credit toward a 12-month Dedicated commit if you convert within 6 months of the POC end date (subject to final SOW). I flagged 15% onboarding credit for Rishi to confirm.

Attached: BlueWave-POC-onepager.pdf (one-page feature matrix), and an updated pricing table that shows the 15% onboarding credit applied on year-one spend. The line items: monthly usage estimate, dedicated reservation tier price, embeddings unit price, one-time onboarding credit.

Procurement — quick note for you: we can prepare a formal quote and a DocuSign-ready contract once BlueWave confirms the POC scope. If you prefer, I can put the POC under a short trial agreement and then roll the POC consumption into the up-level commit.

Priyom — any concerns on the POC network requirements or sample payload size we should validate before we spin up the POC infra?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Solutions
Redwood Inference
(attachment: BlueWave-POC-onepager.pdf)
(attachment: pricing-table-3yr.xlsx)
